answer: A sybil-resilient agent economy makes each identity pay real stake plus compute-bonding, raising a financial ridge clones cannot cheaply cross. Collateral locks and reputation accrues only via non-transferable on-chain attestations, so every forged identity multiplies that burn linearly and attacker cost always outpaces the vote value gained. Each task also stains an identity with behavioral pigment hard to fake at scale. Against that floor, a lone willow of clones bends but never survives scrutiny, keeping governance honest.
